title: Best Weekend Trips from Delhi in November 2026: Where to Go and What to Plan
summary: Where to go from Delhi on a November weekend. Agra, Jaipur, Rishikesh, Jim Corbett, Manali and Udaipur with travel time, weather and route info.
body_markdown:
November changes the equation for weekend trips from Delhi in two ways. The summer heat is completely gone, making outdoor sightseeing at destinations like Agra and Jaipur comfortable for the full day rather than just the morning and evening. And the monsoon is finished, meaning hill station roads are dry, Rajasthan’s skies are clear, and wildlife reserves are reopening after their July to September closures.


The result is that November carries the widest practical selection of weekend destinations from Delhi of any month in the year. The guide below covers them by distance band, so you can match the destination to the time you actually have.


## **How Distance Determines the Weekend Plan**


A 200 km destination gives you two full days at the location. A 400 km destination costs a half-day on travel each way. A 600 km destination works only with an overnight bus that lets you sleep through the journey and wake up at the destination. The weekend trips from delhi november guide below is organised around this reality.


# **Best Weekend Trips from Delhi in November 2026: Distance, Weather and What to Do**


Each destination below includes the distance, the travel time, November weather conditions, and what specifically makes it worth a November visit rather than any other month.


## **Under 200 km: The Saturday Morning Start**


### **Agra, about 227 km, roughly 3.5 hours**


November temperatures in Agra sit between 14 and 28 degrees Celsius. The Taj Mahal at sunrise in November light, with the cold morning mist lifting off the Yamuna, is visually distinct from the harsh midday sun of summer visits. Agra Fort and Fatehpur Sikri are comfortable for extended walking without the 45-degree heat that makes them exhausting from April to June.


The[Delhi to Agra bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-agra-bus-route) covers the corridor in approximately 3 hours 21 minutes. Saturday morning departure, Sunday evening return.


### **Mathura and Vrindavan, about 180 km, roughly 3 hours**


November in Mathura carries the post-Diwali calm. Govardhan Puja on November 9 sees the 21 km Govardhan Hill parikrama at its busiest, but by the following weekend the town returns to a quieter pace. Krishna Janmabhoomi, Banke Bihari Temple in Vrindavan, and the Yamuna ghats are all comfortable to explore in November weather.


### **Neemrana, about 122 km, roughly 2 hours**


Neemrana Fort Palace sits on the Delhi to Jaipur highway. November weather makes the fort’s outdoor areas, the zip line and the rooftop dining comfortable throughout the day. It works as a single-night Saturday to Sunday getaway without the need for a full weekend.


## **200 to 400 km: The Friday Evening or Overnight Start**


### **Jaipur, about 280 km, roughly 5 to 6 hours**


November is Jaipur’s best month. Temperatures between 15 and 28 degrees make the forts, palaces and bazaars comfortable for full-day exploration. The walled city’s UNESCO Heritage Site architecture photographs best in November’s clear light. Mehrangarh Fort in Jodhpur, about 330 km further, extends a Jaipur weekend into a Rajasthan circuit if you take Monday off.


Check current schedules on the[Jaipur bus booking page](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/jaipur-bus-booking-online) .


### **Rishikesh, about 240 km, roughly 5 to 6 hours**


November is prime rafting season. The Ganga’s water levels have settled after the monsoon, the rapids are running at grade 3 to 4 intensity, and the air temperature is comfortable for river activities. Triveni Ghat evening aarti, the cafe strip near Ram Jhula, and the Beatles Ashram are all accessible without the monsoon closures that affect August and September.


### **Jim Corbett National Park, about 260 km, roughly 5 to 6 hours**


Corbett reopens in October after the monsoon closure. By November, the core zones (Bijrani, Jhirna, Dhela) are operational and the early-season game drives benefit from lower tourist density compared to the February to April peak. Morning temperatures drop to 8 to 10 degrees, and a jacket is essential for the open-vehicle safari drives.


### **Lansdowne, about 270 km, roughly 6 hours**


Lansdowne is the quieter alternative to Mussoorie and Nainital. November temperatures between 8 and 18 degrees, the Garhwal Rifles war memorial, Bhulla Tal lake and the absence of commercial tourism infrastructure make it work for a weekend where doing nothing is the point. The cantonment town atmosphere is unlike any other hill station.


## **400 to 600 km: The Overnight Bus**


### **Udaipur, about 660 km, roughly 10 to 12 hours overnight**


The overnight bus from Delhi reaches Udaipur by morning. November in Udaipur means the lakes are full after the monsoon, temperatures sit between 14 and 28 degrees, and the City Palace, Lake Pichola boat ride and Monsoon Palace sunset are all at their best. Two nights give enough time for the core Udaipur experience.


### **Manali, about 540 km, roughly 12 to 14 hours overnight**


November in Manali is the transition month. Rohtang may close for winter. The first snow appears at higher elevations. Old Manali’s cafes are open with fewer visitors than the summer peak. It is the last comfortable month before deep winter sets in. The[Delhi to Manali bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-manali-bus-route) handles the overnight corridor.


### **Amritsar, about 450 km, roughly 8 to 9 hours overnight**


November in Amritsar carries Guru Nanak Jayanti on November 24. The Golden Temple, Jallianwala Bagh, the Wagah Border ceremony and the old city heritage walk are all comfortable in November weather at 10 to 24 degrees.


## **November-Specific Planning Tips**


The post-Diwali weekends (November 14 to 15 and November 21 to 22) see lower crowds at most destinations because many families have already travelled during the Diwali window. Prices at hill stations and Rajasthan hotels drop from Diwali peak rates.


The Guru Nanak Jayanti weekend (November 21 to 24) is the exception. Amritsar sees a demand spike, and the Pushkar Camel Fair runs until November 24, meaning Pushkar and Ajmer are also busier than usual.


Pack layers. November mornings and evenings in North India run 8 to 14 degrees at most destinations. Afternoons are warm enough for a single layer.


Prices are approximate and may vary based on season, demand, and availability.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What are the best weekend trips from delhi november destinations?**


Agra, Jaipur, Rishikesh, Jim Corbett and Udaipur are the strongest November options, each benefiting from post-monsoon weather.


### **Is November a good time for a weekend trip to Jaipur from Delhi?**


November is Jaipur’s best month with temperatures between 15 and 28 degrees, clear skies and comfortable conditions for fort visits.


### **Can I do white water rafting in Rishikesh in November?**


November is prime rafting season with settled water levels, grade 3 to 4 rapids and comfortable air temperatures for river activities.


### **Is Jim Corbett open in November?**


Corbett reopens in October after the monsoon closure. By November the core zones are operational with lower tourist density than peak season.


### **How cold is Manali in November?**


Manali in November ranges from 2 to 15 degrees. It is the transition month before deep winter, with possible early snow at higher elevations.


### **Which destination from Delhi works best for a single overnight trip?**


Neemrana at 122 km is the quickest overnight escape. Agra at 227 km gives a full weekend with the most to see.


### **Are post-Diwali weekends cheaper for travel?**


Post-Diwali weekends in November typically see lower crowds and reduced rates at most destinations compared to the Diwali peak.


### **Is Udaipur reachable for a weekend from Delhi?**


The overnight bus reaches Udaipur by morning. Two nights give enough time for City Palace, Lake Pichola and the core Udaipur experience.


### **What should I pack for a November weekend trip from Delhi?**


Layers for 8 to 14 degree mornings and evenings, a light jacket, comfortable walking shoes and a power bank for overnight bus travel.


### **Is the Pushkar Camel Fair happening in November 2026?**


The Pushkar Camel Fair runs November 17 to 24. It is combined with a Jaipur visit for a longer Rajasthan weekend.
